fix(renderer): edit chrome's open menus live and die with the edit transaction (3248.v73l)

Opening and closing a transaction each drop every key in edit chrome's
namespaces (the configure key, chrome menus, their page cursors), and a
layout step that ends a placement drops that placement's chrome keys in
the same step as its drafts, named through the derivations that mint
them. Retire now ends through the one close. An authored menu whose key
would collapse into chrome's namespace is refused at load.

fix(themes): a stored theme pick naming nothing installed is reported beside the theme the bar wore

A session's theme pick loaded from the profile can name a palette this
build does not ship (a retired name such as 'dark', a renamed or removed
theme). The fold read that pick through the same null arm as no pick, so
the bar wore the config's theme and nothing said why.

The pick is now parsed into its own type, which tells an uninstalled
pick from no pick. The fold still moves past it, and the render reports
it in the palette slot's report, naming the pick and the theme the bar
wore. The pick stays stored, so a build that ships it again draws it.
